texts.name: Kragg Noctirus
texts.biography: Kragg was born into a tribe of night goblins in the depths of the ash swamps. Weak by the standards of his people, he couldn't match their strength, but he possessed a rare quality: the thirst to survive at any cost.When his tribe was wiped out during a nighttime undead raid, Kragg didn't perish.He was turned by an ancient vampire who saw in him not strength, but cunning.

specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Vampirism skill percentage.
specialty.name: Vampirism
